title: Fix metrics_agent_report outputSchema Zod wrapper
description:
The metrics_agent_report tool in packages/rapid-mcp/src/tools/metrics.ts has a bug where the outputSchema is missing the z.object() wrapper.

**Current (line ~518):**
```typescript
outputSchema: {
  agents: z.array(...),
  topPerformer: z.string().optional(),
}
```

**Should be:**
```typescript
outputSchema: z.object({
  agents: z.array(...),
  topPerformer: z.string().optional(),
})
```

This causes a "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '_zod')" error when calling metrics_get or metrics_agent_report.

Quick fix required - 1 line change to wrap the object with z.object().
